definitions.explanation: The measurable extent or degree of something; how much of something there is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{量|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: To reduce the amount of food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{量|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}すぎる→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The amount of work is too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{量|りょう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: Common expression contrasting 質 (quality) and 量 (quantity)

notes:
USAGE: {量|りょう} refers to measurable quantities of things, both physical and abstract.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {量|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧/⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧ (to increase/decrease the amount)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧ (large quantity)
- ⟦{少量|しょうりょう}→少量：12436_shouryou⟧ (small quantity)
- ⟦{適量|てきりょう}→適量：14383_tekiryou⟧ (appropriate amount)
- ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{量|りょう} (quantity over quality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {量|りょう} - quantity, amount (abstract measurement)
- ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧ - number, count (discrete items)
- ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ - quality (antonym concept)
